benefits.name: Travel Policy
benefits.details: Our internal travel policies are designed to help you plan your business trips without any discomfort or hassle.

benefits.name: Mobile Handset Reimbursement
benefits.details: Our corporate sim and mobile handset policy is there to help you remain connected for all your work related needs.

benefits.name: Sabbatical Benefit
benefits.details: If you wish to take a longer period of time off from work to pursue education, you can opt for a sabbatical for up to a year.

benefits.name: Marriage Leave Benefit
benefits.details: While you tie the knot, we do our bit to celebrate for you. Our employees can take up to 5 days of fully paid marriage leave.

benefits.name: Adoption and Surrogacy Support
benefits.details: We extend our support towards all parental choices our employees make. We have a special leave policy for female employees who choose adoption/birth by surrogacy.

benefits.name: Flexible Working Hour Support
benefits.details: If you can’t make it on time, then you can work outside it. Depending on the nature of your role, you can plan your work timings to suit your personal commitments.

benefits.name: Volunteering Leave
benefits.details: Giving back to the society is an ethos that we take very seriously. If you do the same, we support you if you want to take time off for longer term volunteering engagements.

benefits.name: Family Care Leave Benefit
benefits.details: At times, the demands of family might come to the forefront and require your undivided attention. To help you help your loved ones, we give the provision of a long-term family care leave.

benefits.name: Health Insurance
benefits.details: Our comprehensive accident and life insurance policies are designed to protect you and your family from any untoward health incident. Our insurance offers progressive benefits including gender reassignment surgeries.

benefits.name: Insurance Cover
benefits.details: Our comprehensive accident and life insurance policies are designed to protect you and your family from any untoward health incident. Our insurance offers progressive benefits including gender reassignment surgeries.

benefits.name: Joining & Relocation Support
benefits.details: We offer all possible support to welcome you into the Dr. Reddy’s family and make your transition easier. We provide support for the travel of your family, as well as relocation of your belongings and personal vehicle.

benefits.name: Higher Education Benefit
benefits.details: True to our value of dynamism, we encourage you to keep on developing yourself. You can apply for Higher Education courses related to your area of work and the organization will reimburse your fee within reasonable limits.

benefits.name: Child care
benefits.details: The company gives the choice to bring your child to work and use the crèche facility to take care of your child as you work. We want you to work without worrying about your child while you bring expensive medicines within reach.

benefits.name: Maternity and Paternity Benefits
benefits.details: All women employees of our company, can avail fully paid maternity leave up to 26 weeks. Several options for support for new mothers are extended to help them transition back into the professional track smoothly. Fathers provide critical support in childcare, especially in the first few days after the birth of a child and our paternity leave policy is for all new fathers to be by their families during this time.
